description: This file is a front-end HTML page for a Database Viewer web application. It contains structure, styles, and scripts to display databases, tables, and table data with interactive features like refresh, expand, and selection.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell HTML with handling for large objects and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing.
